title: Glad to see you!
statementMd:
**This is an interactive problem. In the output section below you will see the information about flushing the output.**

On Sunday Leha the hacker took Nura from the house where she lives and went with her to one of the most luxurious restaurants in Vičkopolis. Upon arrival, they left the car in a huge parking lot near the restaurant and hurried inside the building.

In the restaurant a polite waiter immediately brought the menu to Leha and Noora, consisting of $*n*$ dishes. It is interesting that all dishes in the menu are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. After a little thought, the girl ordered exactly $*k*$ different dishes from available in the menu. To pass the waiting time while the chefs prepare ordered dishes, the girl invited the hacker to play a game that will help them get to know each other better.

The game itself is very simple: Noora wants Leha to guess any two dishes among all ordered. At the same time, she is ready to answer only one type of questions. Leha can say two numbers $*x*$ and $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$. After that Noora chooses some dish $*a*$ for the number $*x*$ such that, at first, $*a*$ is among the dishes Noora ordered ($*x*$ can be equal to $*a*$), and, secondly, the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5a4a1705bc256e413564795cc8b70857f0ae44c.png) is the minimum possible. By the same rules the girl chooses dish $*b*$ for $*y*$. After that Noora says «`TAK`» to Leha, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a65cb6a9b614699e12e529560e2d39ffa39127db.png), and «`NIE`» otherwise. However, the restaurant is preparing quickly, so Leha has enough time to ask no more than $60$ questions. After that he should name numbers of any two dishes Noora ordered.

Help Leha to solve this problem!

## Input

There are two numbers $*n*$ and $*k*$ $(2 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ in the single line of input denoting the number of dishes in the menu and the number of dishes Noora ordered.

## Output

If you want to provide an answer, output a string of the form $2$ $*x*$ $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*, *x* ≠ *y*)$, if you think the dishes $*x*$ and $*y*$ was among dishes ordered by Noora. After that, flush the output and terminate your program.

## Interaction

While helping Leha, you can ask queries to Noora no more than $60$ times. Each query should be printed in it's own line and have the form $1$ $*x*$ $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$. You have to both print the end-of-line character and flush the output. After flushing you should read the answer for this query from input.

After each query jury's program will print one line «`TAK`» or «`NIE`» (without quotes) in input stream depending on the girl's answer.

To flush you can use (just after printing an integer and end-of-line):

- `fflush(stdout)` in C++;
- `System.out.flush()` in Java;
- `stdout.flush()` in Python;
- `flush(output)` in Pascal;
- see the documentation for other languages.

**Hacking**

For hacking you should write numbers $*n*$ and $*k*$ $(2 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ in the first line and, for describing dishes Noora ordered, $*k*$ different integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$, *written in ascending order* in the second line. Of course, solution you want to hack won't be able to read the numbers of ordered dishes.

## Note

There are three dishes in sample. Noora ordered dished numberes $2$ and $3$, which Leha should guess. If Noora receive requests for the first dish ($*x* = 1$), then she'll choose the second dish ($*a* = 2$) as the dish with the minimum value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5a4a1705bc256e413564795cc8b70857f0ae44c.png). For the second ($*x* = 2$) and the third ($*x* = 3$) dishes themselves will be optimal, because in that case ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/79add195d023131e992b60a354fec89501759e75.png).

Let Leha asks Noora about the next couple of dishes:

- $*x* = 1$, $*y* = 2$, then he'll recieve «`NIE`» answer, because $|1 - 2| > |2 - 2|$
- $*x* = 2$, $*y* = 1$, then he'll recieve «`TAK`» answer, because $|2 - 2| ≤ |1 - 2|$
- $*x* = 1$, $*y* = 3$, then he'll recieve «`NIE`» answer, because $|1 - 2| > |3 - 3|$
- $*x* = 3$, $*y* = 1$, then he'll recieve «`TAK`» answer, because $|3 - 3| ≤ |1 - 2|$
- $*x* = 2$, $*y* = 3$, then he'll recieve «`TAK`» answer, because $|2 - 2| ≤ |3 - 3|$
- $*x* = 3$, $*y* = 2$, then he'll recieve «`TAK`» answer, because $|3 - 3| ≤ |2 - 2|$

According to the available information, it is possible to say that Nura ordered dishes with numbers $2$ and $3$.
statementZhMd:
**这是一道交互题。在下面的输出部分，你将看到有关刷新输出的信息。**

星期日，黑客 Leha 把 Nura 从她居住的房子里带走，和她一起前往 Vičkopolis 最豪华的餐厅之一。到达后，他们把车停在餐厅附近的巨大停车场里，然后匆忙走进了大楼。

在餐厅里，一位礼貌的服务员立即把菜单拿给 Leha 和 Noora，菜单上共有 $*n*$ 道菜。有趣的是，菜单中的所有菜都用 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数编号。女孩稍加思索后，从菜单中的菜品里点了恰好 $*k*$ 道不同的菜。为了打发厨师准备菜品时的等待时间，女孩邀请黑客玩一个能够帮助他们更好地了解彼此的游戏。

游戏本身非常简单：Noora 想让 Leha 猜出所有已点菜品中的任意两道。同时，她只愿意回答一种类型的问题。Leha 可以说出两个数字 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$。之后，Noora 会按照以下规则为数字 $*x*$ 选择某道菜 $*a*$：首先，$*a*$ 必须是 Noora 点的菜之一（$*x*$ 可以等于 $*a*$）；其次，值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5a4a1705bc256e413564795cc8b70857f0ae44c.png) 必须尽可能小。对于 $*y*$，女孩也按照相同的规则选择菜 $*b*$。之后，如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a65cb6a9b614699e12e529560e2d39ffa39127db.png)，Noora 就会对 Leha 说“`TAK`”，否则说“`NIE`”。然而，餐厅的上菜速度很快，因此 Leha 最多只能提问 $60$ 次。之后，他必须说出 Noora 点的任意两道菜的编号。

请帮助 Leha 解决这个问题！

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ $(2 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$，分别表示菜单中的菜品数量以及 Noora 点的菜品数量。

## 输出格式

如果你想给出答案，请输出格式为 $2$ $*x*$ $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*, *x* ≠ *y*)$ 的字符串，表示你认为菜品 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 是 Noora 点的菜。然后刷新输出并终止程序。

## 交互

在帮助 Leha 的过程中，你最多可以向 Noora 询问 $60$ 次。每次询问都应单独输出一行，格式为 $1$ $*x*$ $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$。你必须同时输出换行符并刷新输出。刷新后，应从输入中读取该询问的回答。

每次询问后，评测程序都会根据女孩的回答，在输入流中输出一行“`TAK`”或“`NIE`”（不含引号）。

刷新输出可以使用（在输出整数和换行符之后）：

- C++ 中的 `fflush(stdout)`；
- Java 中的 `System.out.flush()`；
- Python 中的 `stdout.flush()`；
- Pascal 中的 `flush(output)`；
- 其他语言请参阅相关文档。

**Hack**

在进行 hack 时，应在第一行写入两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ $(2 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$；在第二行写入表示 Noora 所点菜品的 $*k*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$，并且这些整数应按升序排列。当然，你想要 hack 的程序将无法读取所点菜品的编号。

## 说明

样例中有三道菜。Noora 点了编号为 $2$ 和 $3$ 的菜，Leha 应该猜出这两道菜。如果 Noora 收到关于第一道菜（$*x* = 1$）的询问，那么她会选择第二道菜（$*a* = 2$），因为此时值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5a4a1705bc256e413564795cc8b70857f0ae44c.png) 最小。对于第二道菜（$*x* = 2$）和第三道菜（$*x* = 3$），它们自身就是最优选择，因为在这种情况下 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/79add195d023131e992b60a354fec89501759e75.png)。

假设 Leha 向 Noora 询问以下几对菜品：

- $*x* = 1$，$*y* = 2$，那么他会收到“`NIE`”，因为 $|1 - 2| > |2 - 2|$
- $*x* = 2$，$*y* = 1$，那么他会收到“`TAK`”，因为 $|2 - 2| ≤ |1 - 2|$
- $*x* = 1$，$*y* = 3$，那么他会收到“`NIE`”，因为 $|1 - 2| > |3 - 3|$
- $*x* = 3$，$*y* = 1$，那么他会收到“`TAK`”，因为 $|3 - 3| ≤ |1 - 2|$
- $*x* = 2$，$*y* = 3$，那么他会收到“`TAK`”，因为 $|2 - 2| ≤ |3 - 3|$
- $*x* = 3$，$*y* = 2$，那么他会收到“`TAK`”，因为 $|3 - 3| ≤ |2 - 2|$

根据已有信息，可以断定 Nura 点了编号为 $2$ 和 $3$ 的菜。

3 2
NIE
TAK
NIE
TAK
TAK
TAK
